about.metaDescription: Advisory Platform is where people in Thailand find real experts to talk to within minutes. Every identity is checked, and payment is held in escrow
about.heroTitleLine1: Good advice shouldn't be hard to find
about.heroBody: We built Advisory Platform because finding someone who really knows, for even an hour, is still far too hard. People with questions don't know where to start. People with answers have nowhere to offer them. We stand in the middle.
about.heroImageAlt: An expert advising over a video call
about.whyTitle: The problem we set out to solve
about.whyBody1: When people face a decision, whether it's a first tax bill, a contract about to be signed or a job they're about to leave, what's missing isn't information. The internet has more than enough. What's missing is someone who actually listens to their situation and can say what they should do in their case.
about.whyBody2: On the other side, people who have worked in that field for ten years and could answer that question in twenty minutes have no proper way to take on small jobs like this. No schedule, no safe way to get paid, nothing to guarantee they'll be paid once the call ends.
about.whyBody3: We bring the two together without either having to trust the other in advance. Identities are checked, time is scheduled, and payment is held until the consultation actually happens.
about.whyImageAlt: Someone reading documents and writing down questions before a consultation
about.beliefBody: We don't rank anyone by promotion budget, and we don't sell places in search. What gets an advisor seen is a checked background, skills backed by proof, and reviews from people who actually paid to talk.
about.vettingTitle: What we check before anyone goes live
about.vettingLead: Every advisor passes these three checks, with no exceptions, and we show the status right on their profile.
about.vettingNote: If what was submitted turns out not to be true, we revoke advising rights immediately and refund every outstanding booking.
about.vetting1Title: Identity verified with an official document
about.vetting1Body: Advisors send a national ID card or passport to our review team. The name on the account must match the document: no nicknames, no pseudonyms.
about.vetting1Proof: Every document checked by a person
about.vetting1ImageAlt: Identity documents on a desk ready for review
about.vetting2Body: Every skill an advisor lists needs proof behind it: a professional licence, a degree or an employment certificate. A skill without proof doesn't appear on the profile.
about.vetting3Body: Reviews come only from people who paid and attended. We keep watching cancellation rates, no-shows and complaints. It isn't a one-time check.
about.vetting3ImageAlt: A screen showing review scores and consultation statistics
about.fieldImageAlt: Experts from many fields available for consultation
about.flow1Title: Pick what you want to talk about
about.flow1Body: Search by field or by your own question. Each service states its price, length and what you'll come away with before you press anything.
about.flow2Title: Book a time that's really open
about.flow2Body: The schedule you see is the time the expert has actually opened, not a request you wait on. Some services ask a few short questions first, so they can come prepared for your topic.
about.flow3Body: Your payment is held by the platform and not passed to the advisor until the consultation is complete. If it doesn't happen, the money comes back to you.
about.flow4Body: Talk over video call in the app and share files in the same chat. Afterwards, rate and review it: that's what the next person uses to decide.
about.team1Body: Works out how many steps a booking should take, and cuts every one that isn't needed.
about.team1ImageAlt: A member of the product team
about.team2Body: Runs booking, payments and data storage in line with Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act.
about.team2ImageAlt: A member of the engineering team
about.team3Body: Reads every identity document, answers complaints and decides refund requests as real people.
about.team3ImageAlt: A member of the trust and support team
about.fieldsLead: We started with what people in Thailand ask about most and where a wrong decision costs the most, and we'll grow with real demand.
about.flowLead: From opening search to hanging up, the admin takes a few minutes. The rest is the conversation.
about.peopleLead: We're a small team in Bangkok who have been both the person who couldn't find an advisor and the person who was asked with nowhere to answer.
about.peopleNote: We're not big yet, and we answer every complaint ourselves. If something isn't right, write to the team directly.
about.joinLead: Both use the same account, and you can change your mind later.

landing.heroBody: Search, book and talk over video call in one place, with every step paid through secure escrow.
landing.aboutBody1: Some questions can't be answered by searching the internet, and chatbots don't go deep enough. Advisory Platform connects you with real, identity-verified experts.
landing.aboutBody2: Search, book, chat, video call and pay, all in one app. No switching between tools.
landing.statPaymentValue: Held until the job is done
landing.step1Body: Pick a category or search a topic
landing.step2Body: Choose an open time and pay
landing.step3Body: Talk in the app, chat and share files
landing.step4Body: Only then is the payment released
landing.know1Body: Everyone verifies their identity with a national ID and sends proof of expertise for our team to review before taking bookings.
landing.know2Title: Payment is held until the consultation ends
landing.know2Body: The system holds your payment, then releases it to the expert once the consultation is complete. If something goes wrong, you can request a refund.
landing.know3Body: Added on top of the expert's price and shown clearly before you pay, every time.
landing.know4Body: Your data is kept in line with the PDPA, and you can ask for your whole account to be deleted at any time.
landing.faqSubtitle: What most people want to know before their first consultation
landing.faq1Question: How do I book a consultation with an expert?
landing.faq1Answer: Choose an expert you're interested in, look at their open times, then book and pay. A video-call room is created automatically and you'll get a reminder before your appointment.
landing.faq2Question: How much does a consultation cost?
landing.faq2Answer: Experts set their own prices. Right now they start at ฿600 for 30 minutes and go up to around ฿1,800 for 90 minutes. The price on the card is for the whole session. The 5% platform fee is added and shown separately before you pay.
landing.faq3Question: Is payment safe? How does escrow work?
landing.faq3Answer: Card details are encrypted and tokenised by Omise. We never store card numbers ourselves. Once a booking is confirmed, the money is held in the system and doesn't reach the expert until the consultation is complete.
landing.faq4Question: How do I know an expert is really qualified?
landing.faq4Answer: Everyone verifies their identity with a national ID and attaches proof for every skill they offer. Our team reviews it before a profile is published. The Verified badge on a card means both checks were passed.
landing.faq5Question: What can I get advice on?
landing.faq5Answer: Six fields are open right now: business, finance, law, education, wellbeing and technology. If you're not sure which one fits, describe your problem briefly and let the system match you with an expert.
landing.faq6Question: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
landing.faq6Answer: Yes. Because your payment is held until the consultation ends, if it doesn't go as agreed you can file a refund request. Our team will review it and return the money to the way you paid.
landing.faq7Question: How is Advisory different from hiring a consultant?
landing.faq7Answer: You pay per session for the time you actually use. No contract and no monthly retainer. Book one hour to ask one thing, then come back and book again whenever you need.
landing.faq8Question: How do I become an advisor?
landing.faq8Answer: Apply from the menu in the app: fill in your details, verify your identity, then list your skills with proof for each. Our team will review it and let you know the result.
landing.ctaBody: Find an expert who fits your situation and book a time today
landing.footerTagline: Consult identity-verified experts, all in one place
